title: Run doctor calls GET /api/doctor and shows the answer next to the button
goal: The live dashboard's Run doctor reports what the service says, never a canned pass
acceptance: A committed test fails first: render helper and a browser test on the production build against the real server
The answer (ok or problems, revision and skew, database checks, update status) stays next to the button until the next run, escaped, tokens only
Unreachable and 401 are said as such; Maya's line only points to Health; the demo says it checked nothing
The guide documents what Run doctor verifies
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: A committed regression fails before the fix
Every test reading live.js, dashboard.js or web/src plus touched tests
escalation: Never show a pass the service did not report

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: one render helper, the live call, a browser test. Not a measurement.
